prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your New Desktop Companion", "Select a pet personality to join your desktop environment.", "Select Pet"]
1: ["Save your newly adopted pet to your cloud account so you never lose progress."]
2: ["Your Pet is Ready for Your Desktop", "Your companion is configured and ready to join your workspace.", "Desktop Pet Controls Overview", "Learn how to summon, dock, or minimize your pet from your screen header.", "Quick Tip", "Got It"]
3: ["Setting up your pet desktop integration while assets render...", "Customize Desktop Preferences", "Set default desktop positioning and sound settings while rendering finishes."]
4: ["Signing in ensures your pet data and personality settings are permanently saved to your account."]
5: ["Preparing Desktop Pet Assets", "Generating high-definition pet animations and desktop taskbar integrations."]
6: ["Feel free to minimize this app. We'll send a system alert as soon as your pet is ready!"]
7: ["Select Your Desktop Pet Experience", "Choose whether to craft a custom AI pet or pick a classic desktop companion.", "Start Path"]
8: ["Upload Photo for Custom Pet Creation", "Upload a clear photo to unlock exclusive custom desktop animations for your pet!", "Bonus Custom Pet Items Included"]
9: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Click launch to summon your pet onto your desktop overlay.", "Launch Pet to Desktop"]

verdicts.problem: Promises bonus items and requests a personal photo upload
